verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state Solid's minimal abstractions give direct DOM access for using native libraries like D3, backed by real DOM elements inspectable via devtools and a render-once model that avoids re-renders interfering with imperative library control. Community testimonials corroborate the low-overhead, fine-grained reactivity that enables this integration pattern, though no explicit hands-on example of a charting-library integration is shown. Missing for 10: a concrete third-party example/tutorial of integrating D3 or another visualization library, and any independent confirmation of ease/pitfalls specific to that integration.
